SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trip_count, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, 
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / (SUM(anglers) + COUNT(*)), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
AND fish_date_doy >= 165 AND fish_date_doy <= 210
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
